requirements.result: Six original global-action rows use keycaps, Change buttons and the Conflict badge. Selected text and the legacy tray binding remain configurable under Other global shortcuts. Original sidebar/artwork/components/tokens are reused.
Island, quick note, clipboard download/history, focus timer, one-hour hide and selected text, plus the legacy tray shortcut, share the same runtime registration owner and settings store.

Keyboard capture supports punctuation, numpad and layout-specific input. Composition, repeated input and modifier-only events are ignored. Typed fallback, cancellation, disabling and explicit saving are tested. Recording alone does not save or dispatch an action.

Start/stop IPC requests are serialized. A late or failed request cannot reorder a later session. Window blur pauses and focus reacquires recording before accepting more keys; session tokens protect cleanup.
Injected RegisterHotKey failure skips the unavailable one-hour hide binding while the other seven remain active. The actual native settings renderer shows Conflict and truthful recovery copy.
A rejected replacement keeps the old shortcut active and leaves its app_settings field unchanged. The candidate/error remains available for retry, and a later valid replacement succeeds.

New registrations precede SQLite save and old-key release. Partial batch failures and failed persistence release candidates and retain old mappings. Release failures remain visible and stale callbacks cannot dispatch.
Native parsed key identity detects equivalent modifier spellings and conflicts across all configurable actions. Disable/re-enable, aliases, multi-field swaps and unaffected bindings are tested.

Current keys route to their current action, removed/disabled keys do not. Registered-key recorder delivery suppresses dispatch. Tray New note captions read the configured key. One-hour hide patches the shared activity preference.

New settings default to Ctrl+Alt+N/T/H, existing custom and empty legacy fields remain supported, unknown settings survive, and custom/disabled bindings persist and rebind after owned process restart.

Default whole-document axe has no violations/incomplete results. Focus is preserved/restored; original SVG callsites/effective geometry are checked. Light Conflict text is slightly darkened to meet AA without changing global tokens.

Frontend/site, format, strict default/spike Clippy, serial Rust tests, release embedding, exact browser/native repeat captures and full M11 PNG audits pass. Failures/raw logs remain; real global keys and OS registration are excluded.

notAutomated: Physical global key input/ownership and real RegisterHotKey reservation against other apps are not executed. The real Tauri adapter propagates registration errors; production transaction/recorder paths are tested using injected outcomes.

No real clipboard/cursor/user profiles/accounts, shell/autostart/notification registration, installers/signing, OS setting changes or fresh idle-performance claim. Other platforms/hardware remain outside this Windows run.
